marc:datafield.marc:subfield: Serving up a healthy education canteen case studies

This program looks at some of the issues facing school canteens, including health and nutrition, food selection and influences on food choices. Explores some of the issues facing school canteens today, including: - health &​ nutrition; food selection in canteens; influences on food canteens; influences on food choices. We case study two schools to illustrate how redesigning canteen food is not only possible, but financially viable. Nutritionists, school council advocates, teachers and students all contribute to this lively program that will challenge and inspire.
